method: Original PNG complete-word and outer blue label-body inspection, with exact original-pixel row profiles; same size/style/padding source recipe

facets.observation: All four complete labels and blue body sides are visible. Monospace I and W bodies have near-equal raster widths 112/113 pixels; default-font bodies are 60/161 pixels. The one-pixel monospace raster difference lies within the preregistered one-pixel edge uncertainty; the two model difference intervals are strictly disjoint. Measurements use outer blue body edges, never ink extent.

candidateIntervalsPx.definition: W-minus-I outer body width differences; one frozen stroke-edge pixel per measured edge gives four-pixel difference uncertainty. A and B candidate intervals, rather than the two equal-width labels themselves, must not overlap.

facets.occlusion: All four complete blue label bodies and glyph strings are separated and inside the registered source window; no third object covers any side.
facets.scope: Finite same-shot relative advance only, allowing the already frozen raster edge uncertainty; no exact fractional advance, font identity, global padding or DPI claim.
